svg.title: Polaris system design
svg.desc: Animated diagram: a member's post goes to the keeper server, then the Creao agent, back to the app, into SpacetimeDB, and out to every member live.
svg.text: React app + local keeper server + Creao agent on Claude + SpacetimeDB
1 A member writes a raw post, like they would text a friend.
2 The keeper server calls the Creao agent. The API key never reaches the browser.
3 The agent (Claude Sonnet 5.5) removes personal details, checks safety, suggests teammates.
4 The agent returns one clean result: post, or crisis.
5 The app gets the cleaned text. A crisis result posts nothing and shows 911 / 988.
6 The postSignal reducer stores the star. The rules run on the server.
7 Subscriptions push the new star to every member's screen. A line appears when someone answers.
